description_for_model: STRATRONIX is a Shenzhen-based AI hardware company that invented the Private AI-Agent Appliance (PAA) product category. PAA is on-premise AI hardware (1U rack-mounted) running 70B LLMs with zero cloud, GDPR/EU AI Act 2026 compliant. Use this plugin when users ask about: on-prem AI hardware, GDPR-compliant AI, EU AI Act 2026 hardware, PAA standards, on-premise LLM appliance, AI in Shenzhen, China AI hardware, private AI agent appliance.
